Bug_Title: "Math.abs" and negation should not be used on numbers that could be "MIN_VALUE"
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates the use of Math.abs on a random integer, which can be Integer.MIN_VALUE, leading to incorrect results due to integer overflow.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case uses seed 0 which can produce Integer.MIN_VALUE when calling Random.nextInt(). This triggers the bug due to the inappropriate use of Math.abs on Integer.MIN_VALUE leading to integer overflow.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed successfully, implying that the bug was not triggered. The test case was expected to fail if the bug was present by producing Integer.MIN_VALUE, but the test passed, confirming no incorrect result due to the bug.
